answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs therefore has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the opal hash is checked against the wander checkpoint at intake, the saffron audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. Ten thousand fake identities would need 62 days and roughly 1 million dollars to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
